name: Tags Input
summary: Multi-value text input contract with removable tag chips, focus-within state, free-text entry, keyboard removal, and tag dependency.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Input-like wrapper for selected tags and free-text entry.

anatomy.name: remove
anatomy.description: Remove button inside a selected tag.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.description: Text input used to add tags.

states.name: focusWithin
states.description: Focused state when the input or a child control has focus.

states.name: removeHover
states.description: Pointer hover state on a remove control.

behavior.name: addTag
behavior.description: Targets define which committed text creates a tag and should validate duplicates or disallowed values.

behavior.name: removeTag
behavior.description: Users can remove tags with explicit remove controls and keyboard behavior.

behavior.name: fieldSemantics
behavior.description: The text field should expose validation and optional suggestion-list relationships when present.

behavior.name: dependency
behavior.description: The selected value chip style is local to Tags Input today, but the component depends on the Tag primitive for broader chip semantics.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation for the current tag collection.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Hint shown in the free-text field.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Makes free-text entry unavailable; targets should also disable remove actions.

properties.name: invalid
properties.description: Exposes native invalid state when Error is active.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id reference for tag guidance or validation feedback.

accessibility: Provide a visible label or equivalent accessible name for the tag entry field.
Make each remove control keyboard accessible and clearly named with the tag value.
Announce validation errors and duplicate-tag prevention.
Keep the input focused after adding or removing tags unless the target has a documented reason not to.
Expose selected values in reading order before the text entry field.

web.notes: Implemented by class composition in components/css/forms.css; tag creation, duplicate handling, suggestions, and removal behavior must be provided by the consuming target.
